query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_students,
  SUM(CAST(feePerQuarter AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as total_quarterly_fee,
  AVG(CAST(feePerQuarter AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as avg_quarterly_fee,
  MIN(CAST(feePerQuarter AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as min_quarterly_fee,
  MAX(CAST(feePerQuarter AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as max_quarterly_fee
FROM students;
